verdict_before_fixes: Facts, CMI/MQA boundary, HRD Corp process, and scholarship conditions were all accurate and identical to en.json. Register had six recurring defects: sentence-initial 它/它们 standing for an abstract subject (calque, banned by zh-register.md rule 7 / checklist 17) in 8 spots; the session unit '指定课程' collided with '课程' meaning the whole programme (ambiguous, not in glossary but flagged in zh-register-audit.json missingRules as needing a distinct session noun); HRD Corp never glossed as 人力资源发展机构（HRD Corp）on first mention per document, contrary to the task's explicit requirement; 'levy' and 'grant' left as bare English with no Chinese gloss; a hedge word 通常 before a quantity and before 会问的问题 (banned, zh-register.md rule 11); 须视…而定 hedge pattern (audit high-confidence item, should drop 须); and 营销 used instead of the Malaysian-register 行销 (zh-register.md rule 16). employer-funding-brief still had residual 班次 (banned; should be 届) that the writer's earlier register_fixes_applied pass missed in one spot.

fixes.reason: '课程' means the whole programme elsewhere in the same documents ('这项课程', '本课程'); reusing it for a single session is ambiguous and inaccurate against the English 'scheduled session'. zh-register-audit.json missingRules calls for a distinct session noun; adopted 研习课.

可以——它专为在职经理人设计 (decision-guide FAQ 3) and 选择一个...——它将成为您的项目 (decision-guide card 1) — 它 here follows an em dash inside the same sentence, not sentence-initial, so it does not violate the rule against 它/这 standing in for an abstract subject at a sentence start.

折扣码或保证 / 课程提供方不保证资助获批 — both are negations describing what the scholarship/funding is NOT (matches the English 'not... a guarantee' and 'funding is not guaranteed'), not a forbidden promise, so 保证 was kept.
用它来判断这项课程... (decision-guide intro) — 它 is the object of 用, not a sentence-initial subject pronoun, so no change needed.
score_rationale: Facts, the CMI/MQA boundary, and HRD Corp mechanics are all precise and match en.json. Register now avoids the calque pronoun pattern, hedge words, and the 课程/研习课 ambiguity, and HRD Corp/levy are glossed on first use per document as instructed. Score held at 8 rather than higher because: the four PDFs still occasionally lean on stacked short clauses in card bodies rather than the press's number-first lede rhythm (zh-register.md rule 2), and a full typography pass (pangu spacing edge cases, decoration-budget audit of every heading) was not exhaustively re-verified beyond spot checks in this session.
